blocks.title: Governed lakehouse pipeline — FinTech & Digital Natives
blocks.note: The flow is linear on purpose: every hop owns its latency budget and failure policy, and a regression in one stage is a cohort, never an estate-wide surprise.

blocks.x: We engineer FinTech & Digital Natives so that regressions are cohorts, not surprises: each stage owns its latency budget and failure policy, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.

items: Fraud industrialized is one of the pressures we hear first in estates like yours — the diagnostic puts a measured number on it before anything is promised.

Events land in seconds, not overnight batches — the precondition for decisions that happen in the moment.

Tested, documented models with lineage exposure — the transform layer your analysts can actually read.
A single governance plane over tables, models and notebooks — access your auditors can replay.
One pipeline from commit to production, with the dashboards that show whether it worked.
Service signals joined to product telemetry — the customer's week visible to the team accountable for it.
Customer truth in one governed place, consent attached to every record.
Behavioral funnels measured end to end — the product decisions argued with usage, not opinion.
Breakage restored and measured — the repair clock starts at alert, not at someone noticing.
Batch windows measured against the plan every run — the number reported is the observed one.
Query latency measured at p95 from real workloads — the number users feel is the number reported.
